items.subject: Gordon Cooper
items.title: NASA-UAP-D023 — Interview Excerpt with Astronaut Gordon Cooper
items.publisher: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office via DVIDS; underlying NASA archival interview

accessibility.altOrMediaDescription: Archival television interview in which Walter Cronkite asks astronaut Gordon Cooper about reports of unidentified flying objects and the possibility of life elsewhere.
accessibility.transcriptStatus: editorial transcript summary published; official DVIDS transcript-download control also exists

items.interpretationBoundary: Establishes Cooper's public 1962 position, not the identity or origin of any specific object.

items.subject: Mercury-Atlas 9 / Gordon Cooper

accessibility.altOrMediaDescription: Audio-only spacecraft communications in which Cooper reports firefly-like luminous particles during Faith 7.

items.subject: Apollo 17

items.medium: mission audio released in video container
items.publisher: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office via DVIDS; NASA Apollo mission audio

items.subject: Apollo 10
items.title: Apollo 10 Lunar Module onboard voice transcript — whistling / space-music sequence
items.medium: NASA onboard voice transcript with synchronized audio available through Apollo Flight Journal

accessibility.altOrMediaDescription: Transcript/audio event in which the Apollo 10 crew hears an intermittent whistling tone and discusses VHF ranging and radar side-lobe explanations.

items.interpretationBoundary: The crew hears a real anomalous sound; the record itself contains onboard radio/ranging hypotheses and no visual-craft claim.
